description: The UNIVERSAL prose->action faculty (the jabberwock's own design): turn ANY grounded prose-procedure into an executable plan in ANY world. The boundary: MECHANISM IS SEEDED, MEANING IS READ, BINDING IS AN EDGE. Seeded ONCE here (domain-blind): the generic OperationPrimitives (what an action achieves: postcondition + role-signature), the thematic roles + the selectional-match role binder, the plan algebra (Act/Seq/Fix/While/Branch) + the execute-on-tick reflex + the satisfaction fold (Fix reuses relax_to_fixpoint), and the operator-selection JOIN. Grounded PER-DOMAIN by reading (never coded): the verb-primitives, the role/noun concepts, the world OPERATORS (a world seed lays Operator--implements-->primitive--applies_in-->Microtheory), and the entities (ingested as nodes). A verb with no enact-able primitive raises an Impasse -> the author-a-new-primitive loop (the taxonomy grows). The navigation game is ONE binding: move->change_location, theme=avatar, goal=goal_cell, arc3_game lays four edges.

microtheory.name: enact
microtheory.description: Comprehension-to-action: a grounded procedure is a PLAN TREE (Act/Seq/Fix/While/Branch) over OperationPrimitives whose role-slots are BOUND to entities of the loaded world by selectional match, whose concrete operator is SELECTED by a graph join on implements/applies_in, and whose goal is the satisfaction FOLD over the tree. Executed on tick(); RESET makes hypothesis-testing penalty-free. The decision lives in the edge set, never in the adapter.

concepts.name: agent
concepts.comment: thematic role: the doer / who acts (the player). theme-role slot.

concepts.name: patient
concepts.comment: thematic role: the entity acted upon / changed.

concepts.name: theme
concepts.comment: thematic role: the entity moved / placed / the figure of the act.

concepts.name: co_theme
concepts.comment: thematic role: the second entity in a binary act (swap/combine with).

concepts.name: instrument
concepts.comment: thematic role: the tool/means by which the act is done.

concepts.name: goal
concepts.comment: thematic role: the to-location/target the act drives toward.

concepts.name: manner
concepts.comment: thematic role: how (the verb's modifiers specialise the primitive).

concepts.name: operation_primitive
concepts.comment: GENUS: a generic action-meaning carrying a POSTCONDITION (the state it produces, a Bool Term over the bound roles) + a ROLE-SIGNATURE. Concrete HOW (the enact operator) is supplied per-world by an implements edge, not here. A verb grounds (genus chain) to one of these.

concepts.name: plan_act
concepts.comment: plan algebra leaf: Act(primitive, bindings) -> emit the bound operator; satisfaction = the primitive's postcondition.

concepts.name: plan_seq
concepts.comment: plan algebra: Seq([p1,p2,...]) from 'then'/','; satisfaction = sat(last) under frame persistence.

concepts.name: plan_fix
concepts.comment: plan algebra: Fix(guard, body) from 'repeatedly B until P' / 'until none remain' -> re-fire body to FIXPOINT; satisfaction = guard. Reuses the relax_to_fixpoint Rust primitive.

concepts.name: plan_while
concepts.comment: plan algebra: While(cond, body) = Fix(NOT cond, body) from 'while P, B'.

concepts.name: plan_branch
concepts.comment: plan algebra: Branch(P, X, Y) from 'if P then X else Y'; satisfaction = sat(taken branch).

concepts.name: satisfaction_fold
concepts.comment: the goal of a plan = a STRUCTURAL fold over its tree (sat(Seq)=sat(last), sat(Fix)=guard, sat(Branch)=sat(taken), sat(Act)=postcondition). Domain-blind: reads only the SHAPE of the composition, never which world the leaves touch.

attrs.name: change_location
attrs.gloss: the theme comes to be AT the goal (move/travel/navigate). HOW: a world operator (router / pick-and-place / ...).

attrs.name: transform_attribute
attrs.gloss: the patient's <attribute> becomes <target> (fry: state raw->golden; toggle: colour flips).

attrs.name: exchange
attrs.gloss: theme and co_theme exchange their positions/values (the sort inner step).

attrs.name: put
attrs.gloss: theme stands in <relation> (on/in) to goal (stack red on blue).

attrs.name: separate
attrs.gloss: the patient is divided (with the instrument).

attrs.name: destroy
attrs.gloss: the patient ceases to exist (clear the lines / remove matched tiles).

attrs.name: signal
attrs.gloss: an act-in-place / point-act (press a button, fire). HOW: the world's act-at-a-point operator.

rules.name: select_operator
rules.comment: THE OPERATOR-SELECTION JOIN — bind each Act to the concrete operator that implements its primitive AND applies in the world the agent is currently in. A graph JOIN (the shared var w), never a Python if. Same verb 'move' -> spatial_router in arc3_game, pick_and_place in blocks_world, purely by which edges the world seed laid.
